turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Daniel. Rachel Tan here. It is good to speak with you for our arranged call. Have you got a quiet place to talk, or would it be more convenient to leave the administrative discussion until another time?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: This is a good time. 我已经找了个安静的地方，可以专心通话。 I have my notes with me, and I would like to keep the conversation fairly concise. There is a travel meeting afterwards, but I am not being called away just yet.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep it focused and leave general correspondence preferences until the end. Let us begin with the routine identification details before moving into the discussion.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identity card number is S six three four nine nine one four X. My date of birth is the fifteenth of December nineteen fifty-five.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I have the discussion notes in front of me. Your objective, as we discussed, is to broaden your portfolio's sources of investment income through emerging-market bonds over a longer investment horizon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want for this transaction is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. Before we get into it, please keep the spoken explanation direct. I would rather have space to make my own notes than work through a presentation while we are on the telephone.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will keep to that format. I recommend this fund because its emerging-market debt exposure supports your aim of broadening your sources of investment income. Its pooled management also suits your preference to delegate rather than select and monitor individual securities.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you for setting out your recommendation. 我把相关文件放在手边了，不用另外找。 Please carry on with the points you need to cover.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, deteriorating credit quality or defaults among its emerging-market bond issuers can reduce the fund's value and disrupt income distributions. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the investment amount. Are you willing to accept investment losses with this allocation as part of your broader portfolio plan?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses with this allocation as part of my broader portfolio plan.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will leave a moment for you to refer to your notes before we move to the instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to buy the fund units. Please use euro as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this investment is 500,000. 我看了自己的笔记，原先考虑的持仓数量是一千份。 For this order, use the quantity I just mentioned from my notes. For the order type, just put it through as— Let me start again: please place a limit order with a limit price of 500 euros per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, using a limit order with a limit price of 500 euros per unit. The transaction currency is euro and the investment amount is 500,000; do you authorise me to place that order?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it, and I authorise you to place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we close, we can settle the correspondence preferences you mentioned. For future portfolio updates, would you prefer a short written overview ahead of our conversation, with the supporting documents kept separately?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A short overview beforehand would be useful. 我通常是在出差途中看邮件，太长的内容很难当场细看。 I do not need the documents pasted into the message itself. I would prefer to open them separately when I am back at my desk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that preference for correspondence. The overview can stay separate from the supporting material, with clear headings so you can find what you need. Would you like routine administrative matters kept in the same message, or handled separately?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Separately, please. My office helps me organise appointments, and I try not to mix those messages with private banking correspondence. They do not need the investment documents. I will read those myself when I have proper time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That is helpful. I will keep the appointment arrangements distinct from the private correspondence. On future calls, is there a practical way to arrange a time while you are travelling, without interrupting your business meetings?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Email me to arrange it rather than trying me without notice. 我的行程还在调整，现在不方便定下通话时间。 Once I have settled where I will be staying, I can reply with a suitable window and tell you which local time I am using.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: An email to arrange the call will work. Please include the time zone in your reply so that we do not make assumptions from your usual location. There is no need to settle the appointment during this conversation.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That is all I needed on the practical side. I have to get ready for the travel meeting now, so I will leave the diary arrangements for my reply. 谢谢你今天把通话安排得很紧凑。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You are welcome, Daniel. Thank you for your time. I will let you get back to your preparations. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. Goodbye.
